comment: Cross-language PropSpec parity golden. BOTH the Rust validator (native/src/motifs/catalog.rs `propspec_parity_golden`) and the TS render path (propSpecGolden.test.ts) assert against this file. Every PropSpec variant must appear here; adding a variant on one side without the other makes one of the two tests fail. Each `valid`/`invalid` sample must differ from `spec.default` so the TS lenient-fallback check can tell kept-from-replaced.
